newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were moderately active. Both Classes traded steady on a small midweek supply.
Steers - part load choice 3 Blacks 1430 lbs 68.75. High select and choice 2-3 1200-1400 lbs 66.00-67.50. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.50-66.00.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 66.00- 66.50 in a narrow test. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 63.50-66.00. Select 1-2 61.50-63.50.
